research_question: Does instructor beauty affect teaching productivity as reflected in student instructional ratings?

ivs.description: Instructor physical appearance rating (average of six judges, shifted to mean zero). This is the main predictor of interest: whether an instructor's beauty affects evaluations.

dv.description: Course overall teaching evaluation score (1 = very unsatisfactory to 5 = excellent); the outcome measuring teaching productivity as reflected in student instructional ratings.

controls.description: Instructor age in years; included as a demographic control.
Number of students who participated in the evaluation; included to control for class evaluation sample size.
Number of students enrolled in the course (class size); included as a course-size control.
Instructor gender (categorical); included as a demographic control.
Indicator for whether the instructor belongs to a minority (non-Caucasian); included as a demographic control.
Indicator for whether the instructor is a native English speaker; included as a demographic/control variable.
Indicator for whether the instructor is on the tenure track; included as a professional-status control.
Course division (upper vs. lower division); included as a course-level control.
Whether the course is a single-credit elective (e.g., yoga) vs. more credits; included as a course-characteristic control.

extracted_analysis.analysis_code:
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# Load dataset
_df = pd.read_csv("teachingratings.csv")

# Core variables for the research question
cols = [
    "eval",
    "beauty",
    "age",
    "students",
    "allstudents",
    "gender",
    "minority",
    "native",
    "tenure",
    "division",
    "credits",
]

df = _df[cols].dropna()

# Regression: teaching evaluations on beauty + standard controls
formula = (
    "eval ~ beauty + age + students + allstudents + "
    "C(gender) + C(minority) + C(native) + C(tenure) + C(division) + C(credits)"
)
model = smf.ols(formula, data=df).fit()

beauty_coef = model.params["beauty"]
beauty_p = model.pvalues["beauty"]

print("Rows used:", len(df))
print("Beauty coefficient:", round(float(beauty_coef), 4))
print("Beauty p-value:", float(beauty_p))
print("R-squared:", round(float(model.rsquared), 4))

# Simple bivariate correlation for context
corr = df[["eval", "beauty"]].corr().iloc[0, 1]
print("Eval-Beauty correlation:", round(float(corr), 4))
